<?php
/**
 * ShipStatic — Lockdown gate.
 *
 * Lets only the allowed addresses into this WordPress site and sends everyone
 * else to the static site. It runs before every PHP file (auto_prepend_file in
 * .user.ini, where the server reads it) and from
 * wp-content/mu-plugins/shipstatic-lockdown.php.
 *
 * Generated by the ShipStatic plugin — do not edit; it is rewritten on every
 * change. Locked out? Open your unlock link. Failing that, replace everything in
 * this file with just <?php — that unlocks the site at once. (Don't delete it
 * while .user.ini still points here: PHP stops with an error when that file is
 * missing.) Then remove the ShipStatic Lockdown lines from .user.ini and
 * .htaccess.
 */

if (!defined('SHIPSTATIC_LOCKDOWN_GATE')) {
    define('SHIPSTATIC_LOCKDOWN_GATE', true);

    (static function (array $cfg): void {
        // WP-CLI and other command-line PHP never go through the web server.
        if (PHP_SAPI === 'cli' || empty($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'])) {
            return;
        }
        // Only seen once WordPress has loaded wp-config.php (the mu-plugin run).
        if (defined('SHIPSTATIC_LOCKDOWN_OFF') && SHIPSTATIC_LOCKDOWN_OFF) {
            return;
        }

        // (No /.well-known/ exception here: certificate files are static and never
        // reach PHP. REQUEST_URI is the raw request, so "/.well-known/../x.php"
        // would otherwise get any PHP file past the gate.)
        $path = (string) parse_url((string) ($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/'), PHP_URL_PATH);

        // The site's own requests (renders, WP-Cron, Site Health).
        $token = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_BS_RENDER_TOKEN'] ?? '';
        if (is_string($token) && $token !== '' && hash_equals($cfg['token'], hash('sha256', $token))) {
            return;
        }

        // The unlock link: WordPress then adds this address.
        $key = $_GET['unlock'] ?? '';
        if (is_string($key) && $key !== '' && hash_equals($cfg['key'], hash('sha256', $key))) {
            return;
        }

        // The unlock key as a bearer token, for scripts and services
        // (Authorization: Bearer <key>). It lets the request through without
        // adding an address, and is taken off so WordPress never sees it (an
        // auth plugin would otherwise try it as its own token and refuse it).
        $auth = (string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? $_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '');
        if (preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(\S+)\s*$/i', $auth, $m) && hash_equals($cfg['key'], hash('sha256', $m[1]))) {
            unset($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'], $_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']);
            return;
        }

        // The unlock cookie (12 hours).
        $cookie = $_COOKIE[$cfg['cookieName']] ?? '';
        if (is_string($cookie) && $cookie !== '' && hash_equals($cfg['cookie'], hash('sha256', $cookie))) {
            return;
        }

        // Form submissions from the static site: a POST to WordPress's own
        // admin-ajax.php (that exact path, and that file running), for one of
        // the listed actions only. Not from the query string or a cookie:
        // admin-ajax.php reads the action from $_REQUEST, which can include them.
        if ($cfg['forms'] !== null
            && ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') === 'POST'
            && $path === $cfg['forms']['path']
            && !isset($_GET['action'])
            && !isset($_COOKIE['action'])
            && isset($_POST['action']) && is_string($_POST['action'])
            && in_array($_POST['action'], $cfg['forms']['actions'], true)
            && realpath((string) ($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '')) === $cfg['forms']['script']) {
            return;
        }

        // Bricks filters and AJAX loops on the static site: the relay route,
        // exactly (prefix, destination id, endpoint), run by WordPress's
        // index.php. Nothing may pick another route: WordPress takes
        // rest_route from the query string or a POST field over the address,
        // so neither may be there (only Bricks' ?lang= for WPML).
        if ($cfg['forms'] !== null && $cfg['forms']['rest'] !== ''
            && in_array($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '', ['POST', 'OPTIONS'], true)
            && preg_match($cfg['forms']['restPattern'], $path) === 1
            && array_diff(array_keys($_GET), ['lang']) === []
            && !isset($_POST['rest_route'])
            && in_array(realpath((string) ($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '')), $cfg['forms']['restScripts'], true)) {
            return;
        }

        // The allowed addresses.
        $ip = @inet_pton((string) $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']);
        if ($ip !== false) {
            if (strlen($ip) === 16 && strncmp($ip, str_repeat("\0", 10) . "\xff\xff", 12) === 0) {
                $ip = substr($ip, 12); // IPv4-mapped IPv6.
            }
            foreach ($cfg['ranges'] as $range) {
                $net = @inet_pton($range[0]);
                if ($net === false || strlen($net) !== strlen($ip)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $masked = '';
                for ($i = 0, $n = strlen($ip); $i < $n; $i++) {
                    $bits    = max(0, min(8, $range[1] - $i * 8));
                    $masked .= chr(ord($ip[$i]) & ((0xff << (8 - $bits)) & 0xff));
                }
                if ($masked === $net) {
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        // Blocked: no PHP beyond this point.
        header('X-ShipStatic-Lockdown: ' . (defined('ABSPATH') ? 'wordpress' : 'gate'));
        header('Cache-Control: no-store');
        if ($cfg['redirect'] !== '') {
            $relative = $path;
            if ($cfg['home'] !== '' && strpos($relative, $cfg['home'] . '/') === 0) {
                $relative = substr($relative, strlen($cfg['home']));
            }
            header('Location: ' . $cfg['redirect'] . ltrim($relative, '/'), true, 302);
        } else {
            http_response_code(403);
            header('Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8');
            echo 'Forbidden';
        }
        exit;
    })(__BS_CONFIG__);

    // Run the auto_prepend_file this one replaced (a firewall, for example).
    if (!defined('ABSPATH') && __BS_CHAIN__ !== '' && is_readable(__BS_CHAIN__)) {
        include_once __BS_CHAIN__;
    }
}
